description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that provides static methods for logging messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It acts as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility, facilitating message logging and chaining of LogNode instances for flexible logging chains. The class includes methods for logging messages with different severity levels, attaching throwables, and configuring the log node destination.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class for managing and routing log messages, providing static methods to log at various levels and configure chain of LogNode handlers.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode that will handle log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the current LogNode.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message or throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assert (wtf) level message, with optional Throwable.
